prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production website hero illustration, one finished wide landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: An imaginative, exceptionally refined origami/papercraft riverside palace in the Himalayan foothills at Rishikesh, for an elegant Indian wedding invitation. This is fantasy wedding artwork, not a photograph or an accurate depiction of a named real resort.
Input image 1: use only as a style, material, detail, and color reference. Match its meticulously folded faceted paper construction, layered architecture, burgundy wine roofs, champagne stone-paper walls and burnished gold details. Do not replicate the portrait crop.
Scene/backdrop: distant layered rose, mauve, wine and ochre folded-paper Himalayan mountains, graceful soft sunset sky. A winding dark wine-colored river snakes across the foreground and curves toward the palace. Gold lantern reflections touch the water.
Subject: a grand, richly layered Indian palace complex placed centrally and slightly right, terraces with long ceremonial stairways, many delicate pavilions and angular burgundy domes, graceful towers and glowing amber window niches. A smaller lantern pavilion sits to the left near a footbridge. Stylized folded cypress trees and paper lotus accents integrate into the landscape.
Style/medium: cinematic handcrafted architectural paper sculpture, high-end luxury editorial illustration, crisp fine folds and edges, tactile paper fibers, extraordinary but disciplined small details, no toy-like rounded plastic shapes. The reference's sumptuous paper palace craftsmanship is the visual target.
Composition/framing: wide landscape cinematic vista viewed slightly from above, complete palace with breathing space above its tallest towers; strongly layered near foreground, river midground, central/right palace and distant mountains. The lower-left foreground is naturally darker and relatively uncluttered so white website title can be added later, but DO NOT include title or graphic overlay in the image. No frame, no UI.
Lighting/mood: luminous warm sunset raking across folded paper edges; amber lanterns glowing among rich wine shadows; intimate, celebratory, tranquil and romantic.
Color palette: dark burgundy wine, champagne parchment, burnished amber/gold, dusty rose mountains; avoid blue, teal, neon or stark white.
Text: none.
Constraints: one single cohesive full-bleed artwork; no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no portraits or people, no UI mockup.
